subject: Kickoff: GuardianLink x Redwood — evidence sharing & pen-test intake
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.p@guardianlink.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@guardianlink.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: GuardianLink x Redwood — pen test intake & evidence exchange

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks for lining this up — excited to work with Redwood on the upcoming assurance work. A few quick items to get us started:

- Scope: you mentioned a SOC 2 readiness pen test + vulnerability assessment for the inference control plane (api.redwood.ai) and the dedicated deployment admin endpoints. Please confirm the canonical hostnames and any IP allowlist.
- Evidence exchange: we can accept artifacts via our secure portal or an S3 bucket with temporary creds. For larger log bundles we prefer S3.
- Required docs: please return the intake form attached (guardianlink-intake-form.pdf) with the asset inventory, contact list, and expected test windows.
- Timeline: propose kickoff call next week (Tue/Wed) and a two-week reconnaissance + QA window.

Action requested from you: attach the assurance manifest (CSV or ZIP), confirm preferred upload method (portal vs S3), and give a point-of-contact for engineering + compliance.

I'll also loop in our third-party pen test partner, Newton GRC, to coordinate scoping if that's acceptable.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Partnerships Manager | GuardianLink Security
asha.p@guardianlink.com
Attachment: guardianlink-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.p@guardianlink.com>, GuardianLink Security <security@guardianlink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GuardianLink x Redwood — pen test intake & evidence exchange

Hi Asha — thanks, this looks good. Looping in the internal leads: Marissa (Customer Success lead), Vivek (Platform infra), and Neha (Security & Trust).

Quick answers / notes:
- Canonical endpoints: api.redwood.ai (inference) and admin.redwood.internal (admin plane; reachable via VPN for private deployments). We'll provide a short asset list in the manifest.
- Evidence delivery: we prefer S3 for bulk artifacts (logs, captures). We can create a short-lived bucket and hand over IAM role credentials scoped to a prefix. Confirm you support SSE-KMS encrypted objects.
- Retention & access: artifacts should be retained for 90 days unless otherwise agreed; please confirm deletion after the engagement.
- Intake form: attached is our initial manifest (rdw-assurance-manifest.csv) with service owners and tentative test windows.
- Kickoff: Tue Apr 13 or Wed Apr 14 works for us — suggest Tue 10:00 AM PDT for a 45-minute scoping call.

Next steps I propose:
1) GuardianLink confirms acceptance of S3 + KMS workflow and provides an S3 prefix + IAM role ARNs you require.
2) We provision a temporary bucket and create a short-lived IAM role (scoped to prefix).
3) Sign NDA (if Newton requires) and confirm test windows + asset list.

Contact details: Diego Fernandez — diego_fernandez@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0143

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: rdw-assurance-manifest.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@newtongrc.io>
To: Asha Patel <asha.p@guardianlink.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: GuardianLink x Redwood — pen test intake & evidence exchange

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@newtongrc.io>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood intake
To: Asha Patel <asha.p@guardianlink.com>

Thanks for the ping — copying the email into our intake queue. A couple of asks from the pen-test side:

- Asset scope: please provide a clear list of FQDNs and any associated cloud account IDs (AWS account numbers).
- IP allowlist and scheduled windows: if you run tests against production-facing endpoints, we need explicit windows and a point-of-contact reachable by phone during the window.
- Sensitive handling: for artifacts that contain PII or customer data, we require encrypted delivery and an artifact manifest that flags sensitive items.
- Paperwork: please route the standard NDA to the signatory at Newton — I can provide a DocuSign link.

We can accept uploads to S3 with SSE-KMS; please share KMS key ID and allowed prefix. We will provide a short checklist for log formats and sample manifests after the kickoff.

Looking forward to the call next week.

— Liam O'Connor
Security Engagement Lead | Newton GRC
Attachment: newton-nda-docusign.pdf (DocuSign envelope)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00

Thanks team — quick status update and coordination notes:

- Confirmed kickoff: Tue Apr 13, 10:00 AM PDT (45 min). Calendar invite sent to all external participants.
- Security: Neha, can you confirm the KMS key we use for the temp bucket and the deletion/retention policy?
- Infra: Vivek, please provision a bucket at s3://redwood-assurance/guardianlink-dl-7831/ with the following prefix: uploads/. Create an IAM role named guardianlink-ingest-role with read/write on that prefix and a policy that forbids deletion of objects by default (we'll handle lifecycle). Expiration: 14 days.
- Legal: I've uploaded the DocuSign NDA link to the ticket and shared it with Liam for signature (see related_links).

I've created internal Jira ticket INF-7629 to track provisioning, keys, and post-engagement cleanup. Please update the ticket when provisioning is done.

Vivek: any blockers on rotating the temporary creds post-engagement?

Marissa Cole
